files.README.md:
# Fernhall Bakehouse

Delivery exports live at the top level. The monthly file is named deliveries-YYYY-MM.csv.
The restore tool keeps .bak snapshots of retired notebook exports; those snapshots can be
stale and only cover part of a month.

turns.prompt: Fernhall Bakehouse stocktake. The September flour sheet - our runner saved it as deliveries-sept.csv at some point - how many bags of flour arrived in September 2026 in total? Just the number.
Hold on - the market-run deliveries are billed from the stall float, so they don't belong in the kitchen's flour total. Give it again without those. The bare number, please.
Which supplier made the biggest single September delivery in that sheet?
